programme.title: Donovan's Reef
programme.desc: Acclaimed director John Ford and screen legend John Wayne team up for what would be their final collaboration in this boisterous, rowdy South Seas escapade.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: The Knack...And How To Get It
programme.desc: Sophisticated Tolen has a monopoly on womanizing while the awkward Colin desperately wants a piece of it. When Colin falls for an innocent girl, it's not long before Tolen moves in for the kill. Can Colin get The Knack and beat Tolen at his own game?

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: Ninjitsu master Frank Dux journeys to Hong Kong to enter the Kumite, the Olympics of martial arts, and meets a beautiful American reporter. Before long he must face Chong-Li, a vicious Korean master of Tae Kwan Do, in a climactic fight to the finish.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

programme.title: Crazy Fist
programme.desc: After an opponent dies mid-match, a prominent MMA champion swore never to fight again and retired to run his family’s company. But when his best friend dies under suspicious circumstances, he has no choice but to step back in the ring.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: Legendary action director Yuen Woo Ping draws on a stellar cast (Michelle Yeoh, Dave Bautista, Tony Jaa, and Max Zhang) to create a hard-hitting martial arts blast worthy of its place in the celebrated IP MAN universe.

programme.title: Canadian Bacon
programme.desc: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy, cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Mr. Mom
programme.desc: Michael Keaton plays a husband and father who loses his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant. After struggling to find another job, his wife lands a high paying position at an advertising agency.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.

programme.title: Steel Magnolias

programme.title: Dirty Dancing

programme.title: Lord of War

programme.title: First Reformed

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy, an overextended payroll executive, lures his younger brother, Hank, into a larcenous scheme: the pair will rob a suburban mom-and-pop jewelry store that appears to be the quintessential easy target.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday

programme.title: Paint Your Wagon

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)

programme.title: Hostile Takeover
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: A professional hitman faces a group of assassins after the boss of a crime syndicate suspects disloyalty due to his attendance at Workaholics Anonymous meetings.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: May
programme.desc: May grew up as a lonely oddball whose only friend was a perfectly kept doll. When she moves to L.A., she takes up with a handsome filmmaker and then an alluring lesbian, but every connection she makes turns out deadly.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Greatest Show On Earth

programme.title: Roustabout
programme.desc: Elvis is a karate-chopping biker who’s hired as a carnival Roustabout. At first he just provides muscle and a diversion for the beautiful carny girls. Then he picks up a guitar and gets the midway rockin’.

programme.title: King Creole
programme.desc: Elvis Presley gives Bourbon Street a new beat in King Creole. He plays a troubled youth whose singing sets the French Quarter rockin’.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Commando (1985)
programme.desc: An ex-commando is pressed back into service when his daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Paradox
programme.desc: When his daughter goes missing, a police negotiator (Louis Koo) teams with local police (Tony Jaa) to find her, but instead finds himself embroiled in a web of corruption and violence in this explosive thriller from director Wilson Yip.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: After being blinded in a coup against the king, Joseon’s greatest swordsman goes into hiding, far removed from his city’s anguish. But when traffickers kidnap his daughter, he has no choice but to unsheathe his sword once more.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Stoke (Billy Bob Thornton) returns as "Santa," this time in an effort to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. It's a hysterical sequel just outrageous enough to outdo the original.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: The Matador
programme.desc: A globetrotting hitman and a salesman form an unlikely relationship after meeting at a hotel bar in Mexico City.

programme.title: Predestination
programme.desc: For his final assignment, a top temporal agent must pursue the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time. The chase becomes a unique, surprising, and mind-bending exploration of love, fate, identity, and time-travel taboos.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Old ways die hard. It's the lesson learned by Carl Lee Hailey, a Mississippi factory worker, when two racist thugs brutally assault his ten-year-old daughter on a drunken spree.

programme.title: True Grit (1969)
programme.desc: The cantankerous Rooster is hired by a headstrong young girl (Kim Darby) to find the man who murdered her father and fled with the family savings.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.title: King Creole

programme.desc: Elvis heads south of the border, where he’s fired as a boat hand, hired as a lifeguard and singer, admired by local beauties and inspired to jump off a 136-foot cliff. Put another way: he overcomes a fear of heights in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: G.I. Blues
programme.desc: Elvis adopts an on-screen persona he knows well in real life-a singin' G.I. in West Germany. Eager to open a stateside nightclub after his hitch in khakis, he takes part in a wager to raise the dough he needs.

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Officer Cole is assigned to infiltrate the syndicate of God, a deadly crime lord. But as Cole sinks deeper into God's crew, he begins to get in over his head, until the line that separates his true identity from his street persona begins to disappear.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: After being blinded in a coup against the king, Joseon’s greatest swordsman goes into hiding, far removed from his city’s anguish. But when traffickers kidnap his daughter, he has no choice but to unsheathe his sword once more.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Bloody revenge is at the heart of this stylish action-thriller that doses the classic femme fatale story with a shot of adrenaline as it follows a former assassin who will stop at nothing to cut ties to her past.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahilo are two high school girls who are about to graduate. They also happen to both be highly skilled assassins. When the organization they work for orders them to share a room, the relationship between them turns sour.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Stoke (Billy Bob Thornton) returns as "Santa," this time in an effort to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. It's a hysterical sequel just outrageous enough to outdo the original.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Predestination
programme.desc: For his final assignment, a top temporal agent must pursue the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time. The chase becomes a unique, surprising, and mind-bending exploration of love, fate, identity, and time-travel taboos.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: Old ways die hard. It's the lesson learned by Carl Lee Hailey, a Mississippi factory worker, when two racist thugs brutally assault his ten-year-old daughter on a drunken spree.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: True Grit (1969)
programme.desc: The cantankerous Rooster is hired by a headstrong young girl (Kim Darby) to find the man who murdered her father and fled with the family savings.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Lifelong friends begin experiencing the "night terrors" that plagued them as children, convincing them that a supernatural force is pursuing them.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: Something Wild
programme.desc: A conservative executive accepts a ride with a wild, eccentric woman, who takes him on an outrageous odyssey that turns both their worlds upside down.

programme.title: The Time Machine
programme.desc: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th-century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: When a couple of young astronomers discover an enormous comet on course to collide with Earth, the countdown to doomsday begins, and the human race embarks on the fight for survival.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone—a critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Reservoir Dogs
programme.desc: After a seemingly perfectly planned robbery goes awry, a group of criminals begins to suspect a traitor in their ranks, and back at their headquarters, they try to suss out the culprit.

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: In a gym bag. That's how three men size up what they've found in the snowy Minnesota woods. They've come across a downed plane with a rotting corpse inside...and over $4 million stuffed inside a duffel bag. Finders, keepers? Maybe.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Colonel Terry Childers is a patriot and war hero. But when a peacekeeping mission he leads in Yemen goes terribly wrong, he finds himself facing a court-martial.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: When an ancient Egyptian artifact is discovered, two men unlock its secret power as a portal through time and space.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: In one of his most memorable roles, Burt Reynolds portrays a moonshine whiskey runner who turns state's witness to avenge the murder of a boy no one understood.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: The Matrix Revolutions
programme.desc: In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The Cimmerian warrior slashes his way across Hyboria on a mission that begins as a personal vendetta but turns into an epic battle against a supernatural evil.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A defiant mortal (Brenton Thwaites) forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) to save the world from Set (Gerard Butler), the merciless god of darkness.

programme.title: Man on Fire (2004)
programme.desc: A Marine swears vengeance on those who committed an act against the family he was hired to protect.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: The USS Alabama receives an unconfirmed order to launch its missiles.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Shaft (2000)
programme.desc: Who delivers ten times out of ten? Samuel L. Jackson is SHAFT, the man and the movie. John Singleton ("Boys 'n' the Hood") directs this gritty, action-packed thriller.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: On a rescue mission, the USS Enterprise is attacked by Krall, a warlord sworn against the Federation. Crashed on an uncharted world, the crew must join forces with Jaylah, a rebellious alien warrior, to escape and stop Krall from triggering all-out war.

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: The greatest adventure of all time begins with Star Trek, the incredible story of a young crew's maiden voyage onboard the most advanced starship ever created: the U.S.S. Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: When a ruthless mastermind, Khan (Benedict Cumberbatch), declares a one-man war on the Federation, Captain Kirk (Chris Pine), Spock (Zachary Quinto), and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise set out on their most explosive manhunt of all time.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Bebe's Kids
programme.desc: When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

programme.title: Friday

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs to his lottery-winning uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Samson and Delilah
programme.desc: The glorious epic style of Cecil B. DeMille is exemplified in this story of the Bible's legendary strongman and the woman who seduces, then betrays him.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: The Rock
programme.desc: A weapons expert and a prisoner join forces to avert a catastrophe.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: A single mother and her two sons discover much more than they anticipated in this visually stunning blend of hip humor, horror, and rock 'n' roll about the most compelling group of contemporary vampires ever to put fang to vein.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
programme.desc: A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: After the agency suspends its top assassins, aspiring hitmen decide to eliminate them—leading to a lightning-fast showdown between trained killers.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.

programme.title: Man Of Tai Chi
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves makes his directorial debut in this explosive martial arts drama that reunites him with legendary Matrix Trilogy fight choreographer Yuen Wo Ping and stuntman Tiger Chen.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: A small-town singer moves to the big city for her chance at stardom when she discovers Burlesque, a glamorous nightclub packed with dancers, sizzling musical numbers, and an owner in need of a star.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western, starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman, and Wes Studi as Geronimo, who delivers a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: In this edgy and darkly humorous Western, a mysterious young woman rides into the lawless town of Redemption to settle an old score that has haunted her since childhood. She becomes swept up in a deadly quick-draw tournament. Rated: R

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero; we got a hedgehog. Superpowered with speed, Sonic races to save the world and stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from world domination. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz, and James Marsden star in the adventure that the whole family will enjoy.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: The Mummy (1999)
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz star in this nonstop action epic about the discovery of a long-lost treasure in the Egyptian desert that also unearths a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror!

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and an all-star cast reunite in this action-packed adventure where an accursed mummy is resurrected – along with a force even more powerful: The Scorpion King (The Rock).

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: Josh Hartnett (The Black Dahlia, Pearl Harbor) crosses over to the dark side in this bone-chilling adaptation of the cult-hit graphic novel, brought to the screen in all its demonic glory.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days
programme.desc: Almost a year has passed since vampires decimated Barrow, Alaska’s population. Stella, mourning her husband’s murder, has been traveling the world trying to convince others that vampires exist.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Modern Girls
programme.desc: Three young ladies who are looking for love realize that their friendship is more important than romance.

programme.title: 52 Pick-up

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: A través de una combinación de circunstancias, Willy se convierte en el rey muy mimado de un pulgón perdido escuchado. Pero cuando los pulgones realmente necesitan a su "rey" para protegerlos, Willy necesitará la ayuda de Maya.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy cruzan el bosque para ver una flor muy rara, la flor de luna, pero quedan atrapados por la noche y se pierden. Por suerte, pueden contar con una luciérnaga para ayudar a encontrar el camino de regreso

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya ha mojado accidentalmente las alas de Beatrice. Ha perdido algo de su pólvora y ya no puede volar. Maya tiene que encontrar una solución para ayudarla, ya que la gran bola de mariposa se acerca rápidamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Harto del protocolo pesado, la Reina decide dejar la colmena por un momento para visitar el prado. Ella conoce a Maya que está encantada de hacer que la Reina descubra su universo. Pero sin la Reina, la colmena se acerca al caos

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!

programme.title: Shimmer y Shine

programme.title: Dora y sus Amigos: En la Ciudad!

programme.title: Dora La Exploradora

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Los primos de Flip llegan al prado. Cuando están todos juntos, extrañamente cambian su color y su comportamiento. Como Flip también está cambiando, Maya se da cuenta de que podría perder a su amigo. ¡Ella hará cualquier cosa para recuperarlo!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy han atrapado varroas, una especie de piojos de abeja. La colmena está infectada. Deciden pedir a las abejas silvestres del bosque consejos sobre cómo deshacerse de estos parásitos

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy rompen el caparazón de Shelby por error. Tienen que encontrar una manera de reparar la grieta antes de que se ponga peligroso para su amigo.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya quiere ayudar al Escarabajo de la señorita Rosie, una anciana que perdió su casa durante una tormenta. Ella quiere encontrar a su hermano que vive en un viejo árbol al otro lado del estanque.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: El Juez Beeswax está visitando la colmena. Es testigo de un accidente causado por Maya. Decide establecer una licencia de vuelo. Ahora las abejas tienen que permanecer en el suelo y no pueden hacer su trabajo correctamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya conoce a una linda peluca que es un verdadero artista y esculpe todo lo que ve. Pero su arte es malinterpretado por los otros que tienden a rechazarlo. Maya le ayudará a ser aceptado por la comunidad

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya juega con pequeñas chinches. Pronto se da cuenta de que están solas y trata de encontrar a su madre. Ella descubre que la madre está desesperada por darles de comer.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Sin saberlo, Willy se come el pastel de la Reina. Junto con Maya, tratarán de encontrar la receta y hacer un nuevo pastel antes de que todos en la colmena se den cuenta de que el pastel ha desaparecido

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya se encuentra con una colonia de polillas que cruzan el prado. Ella trata de ayudarles a encontrar la dirección correcta para su nido, ya que son muy peligrosos para los otros insectos. ¡Sus pelos están provocando erupciones a quien los toca!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya hace amistad con un abejorro. Cuando las avispas roban la miel de un mensajero especial, Syrphie ayuda a Maya a recuperarla, fingiendo ser unas avispas entre Stinger y sus amigos.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Shelby sueña con volar. Maya y Willy quieren ayudarlo a cumplir su sueño. Pero las cosas no salen según lo planeado

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Es el festival de primavera. Maya y Willy están emocionados, la colmena vecina ha decidido ofrecer a la colmena de pradera un tulipán lleno de polen. Pero el convoy es atacado por las avispas

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy descubren una flor que hace delicioso néctar. ¡Pero sólo queda uno en el prado! Maya decide polinizar la flor para crear nuevas flores

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Max está enamorado de una hermosa oruga. Ayudado por Maya, trata de convertirse en su amigo y pasar algún tiempo con ella. ¡Pero de repente, ella desaparece para convertirse en una mariposa!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Tekla está enferma, pero nadie se atreve a acercarse a ella. Maya siente lástima por ella y decide ayudarla. Ella le pregunta a la Reina si puede conseguir algún propóleo para curarla, pero la Reina se niega

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Para una fiesta, la Reina quiere volver a ver a un famoso cantante de abejas, que solía hacer equipo con el músico Flip. Maya decide encontrarlo, Pero la abeja ya no quiere cantar

programme.title: Blaze y Los Monster Machines
programme.desc: AJ y Blaze se encuentrar en la feria con muchos juegos. Crusher intenta hacer trampa en uno de los juegos de la feria en el que Pickle había ganado, pero lo único que consigue es quedar atrapado junto a Pickle en un cohete gigante.

programme.title: Top Wing

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Los castores arman un increíble parque acuático en un barranco de Gran Remolino. El agua pone en peligro a un grupo de dodos y amenaza con destruir el barranco. Los cadetes se apresuran bajo tierra para salvar a los dodos y al barranco.

programme.title: Top Wing

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Oso Superviviente se va a sumergir en el agua. Penny y el resto del equipo tienen que rescatarlo usando el Command Flyer.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Dora y sus Amigos: En la Ciudad!

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.desc: Tras las numerosas hazañas que han realizado hasta la fecha, Luffy por fin es conocido y ponen precio a su cabeza: 30 millones de berris.

programme.title: One Piece - East Blue Saga: ¡Persigue a Sombrero de Paja! La gran aventura del pequeño Buggy
programme.desc: La acción da un pequeño giro y se centra en Buggy, quien está sin buena parte de su cuerpo, y vive una gran aventura mientras busca a su tripulación.

programme.desc: Luffy y sus compañeros siguen con su viaje y harán un alto en el camino para conocer Loguetown, la ciudad donde Gold Roger fue ejecutado hace 22 años.

programme.desc: Ya en Loguetown, Zoro insiste en que necesita comprar dos espadas más para sentirse seguro. En ese momento conoce a una chica que le recuerda muchísimo a Kuina y que pertenece a la Marina.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¿La primera fortaleza? Aparece Laboon, la ballena gigante
programme.desc: Luego de su alocada entrada al Grand Line, los Sombrero de Paja se topan con una pared enorme. Esta pared resulta ser Laboon, una ballena gigante que es cuidada por un extraño anciano desde hace años.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Una promesa entre hombres! Luffy y la ballena prometen verse de nuevo

programme.title: Kamen Rider Ryuki

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O

programme.title: iCarly

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mello irrumpe en el cuartel de SPK para recuperar una foto suya y asegurarse de no ser asesinado por Kira, a cambio de que Near le regrese la foto, Mello le cuenta una pista importante sobre los Death Notes: algunas de las reglas son falsas.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O

programme.desc: Theresa y Karl acusan a Pedro de que la maestra los castigo por su culpa, deciden atacar a Heidi y Pedro hasta que llegan a la antigua mansión del abuelo, en el ático quedan atrapadas Heidi y Theresa, los chicos deben unirse para ayudarlas.

programme.title: Heidi: Cuidado con el lobo
programme.desc: Una cabra es atacada mientras Heidi se encuentra un cachorro, lo que no sabe es que es un pequeño Lobo. En el pueblo vaga una loba que acaba de atacar a una cabra y el pueblo teme por que sean atacados.

programme.title: Heidi: El tesoro de Pedro
programme.desc: La primavera ya regreso y Pedro y Heidi están listos para abrir la casa del árbol, se da cuenta Pedro que su tesoro no esta, ellos sabe quienes fueron, el abuelo les aconseja un plan para que los delincuentes confiesen.

programme.title: Heidi: Ataque en la casa del árbol
programme.desc: William, Karl y Theresa toman la casa del árbol, furioso Pedro quiere usar la fuerza para sacarlos, pero Heidi tiene un plan más creativo para espantar a los chicos de la casa del árbol.

programme.title: Heidi: Salvando a Encanto
programme.desc: La pequeña cabra que fue atacada por el Lobo ya no quiere dar leche, los dueños quieren sacrificarla, pero Heidi hace un último intento con amor para que la cabra vuelva a dar leche. ¿lo logrará?

programme.title: Heidi: El fin de la primavera
programme.desc: La tía de Heidi regresa al pueblo para llevarse a Heidi a Frankfurt, el abuelo se niega a dejarla ir, después de una discusión con la tía accede que se lleven a Heidi. Pedro y el abuelo no quieren que se vaya.

programme.title: Dora y sus Amigos: En la Ciudad!
programme.desc: Mientras acampan, Dora y sus amigos conocen a un dragón que come tantos malvaviscos, que ahora tiene dolor de barriga. Nuestros amigos tienen que volver a ponerlo en forma, así puede defender el mundo de las hadas nuevamente.

programme.title: Dora La Exploradora
programme.desc: Dora y Botas tienen que ayudar al Hada Madrina a arreglar su varita mágica, para que pueda recuperar a su perrito.

programme.title: Dora La Exploradora
programme.desc: Dora, Botas, y Diego parten para rescatar a los animalitos de colores, el conejo, las tortugas y la mariposa para llevarlos a su hogar en el Árbol de Copal.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Sammy, la perezosa está visitando a Diego en el Centro de Animales Rescatados cuando reciben una llamada de ayuda.

programme.title: Blaze y Los Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze junto a sus amigos competirán en la carrera a la cima del mundo, deberán llegar a la montaña más alta del mundo para ganar. Una vez comenzada la carrera Crusher hace una máquina de tornados que logra sacar de a todos los competidores.

programme.title: Blaze y Los Monster Machines
programme.desc: Los Monster Machine continúan recorriendo el mundo para volver a la carrera a la cima del mundo. Deberán atravesar el océano y la jungla logrando así volver a la carrera de la Cima del Mundo.

programme.title: Dora La Exploradora
programme.desc: Dora y Botas corren para llevar la linterna de Dora a la Biblioteca, antes de que esté demasiado oscuro para la hora del cuento de los pollitos.

programme.title: Dora La Exploradora
programme.desc: Dora y Botas quieren ir a la Gran Colina Roja a encontrar al Gran Pollo Rojo, ¡pero primero necesitarán de tu ayuda para atravesar el Puente, el Portón y la Gran Colina Roja, además de encontrar a ese zorro escurridizo, Swiper!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Los Bubble Guppies llegan a la Bahía de Ciudad Burbuja y encuentran a Sandy que los ayuda a llegar al otro lado para Ciudad Burbuja. Los niños toman un atajo a la ciudad pero se encuentran con un dragón.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Cuando el día de mudanza de su amigo Skip no sale como lo habían planificado, Molly, Gil y el resto de los amigos cola de pez deciden ir a ayudar y salvar el día. Una pijamada sorpresa en la nueva casa de su amigo Skip será la recompensa.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Cuando Cachorro Bubble desaparece después de haber mordido un antiguo hueso mágico, Gil y los Guppies embarcan en una épica aventura para encontrarlo. Siguen el camino místico que los lleva a una isla muy secreta de cachorros perdidos.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Una jorobada bebé ballena queda atapada en una isla rocosa y no puede volver al océano, por lo que Diego decide ayudarla.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Fallaste! La Decisión Final De Kakashi
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura hacen todo lo posible para aprobar el examen de supervivencia. ¡Pero serán necesarios los sabios consejos de Kakashi para enseñarles a estos ninjas egoístas lo que significa trabajar en equipo!

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros comienzan sus primeras misiones ninja. Son tareas aburridas, enojadas y frustradas, y Naruto se alivia diciéndole todo al Hokage. Entretenido por el entusiasmo de Naruto, les asigna una nueva misión: proteger al viejo Tazuna.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Neblina
programme.desc: Naruto y su grupo llegan a Tierra de las Olas,donde un malvado hombre llamado Gato se apodero del lugar. Allí aparece Zabuza, contratado por Gato para matar a Tazuna. Naruto está deseando enfrentarse a este asesino ninja. ¿Estará listo para este desafío?

programme.title: Naruto: El Juramento Del Dolor
programme.desc: Kakashi se pone delante durante la batalla contra Zabuza. Pero ¡todo cambia cuando Kakashi es atrapado en la Prisión de Agua de Zabuza! Kakashi pide que huyan, pero Naruto recuerda la promesa que hizo -no volver a huir nunca más- y se mantiene firme!

programme.title: Naruto: Kakashi: Guerrero Sharingan
programme.desc: Gracias al plan de Naruto, Kakashi se libera de la Prisión de Agua y derrota a Zabuza. Un misterioso ninja aparece de repente y acaba con Zabuza antes de que Kakashi lo haga. Naruto se sorprende al ver que un muchacho ha podido derrotar a Zabuza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Bosque Del Chakra
programme.desc: Kakashi no está satisfecho con el resultado de la batalla, cree que Zabuza no ha muerto. Kakashi decide poner en marcha un interesante entrenamiento que permitirá a Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura controlar mejor su chakra.

programme.title: Naruto: El País Donde Existió un Héroe
programme.desc: Sakura y Tazuna van a la aldea, y ven sufrimiento de habitantes de la Tierras a causa de Gato, por eso Tazuna arriesga su vida. Con un puente, los habitantes no dependerían de Gato, quien controla todos los negocios. Naruto y Sasuke continúan entrenando.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Naruto: Las Armas Conocidas Como Shinobi
programme.desc: Haku le pide a Naruto que lo termine. Naruto cuestiona a Haku y su existencia solo para luchar y ganar. Kakashi y Zabuza alcanzan el clímax y Kakashi retiene el movimiento de Zabuza. Con la victoria a su alcance, lanza su devastador ataque.

programme.title: Naruto: El Demonio De La Nieve
programme.desc: Naruto enfrenta a Zabuza. Aunque parece no tener emociones, Zabuza está desolado por la pérdida de Haku, la única persona del mundo en la que podía confiar. Naruto se da cuenta de que esta cruel realidad es el destino de los ninjas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡La vela diabólica! Lágrimas de remordimiento y lágrimas de ira
programme.desc: Mr. 3 aparece frente a todos contando todo su plan y aprisiona en su cera a Zoro, Nami y Vivi. Con los gigantes derrotados, ¿quién podrá salvar a Zoro antes de que se corte sus propias piernas?

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Cae un maleficio sobre Luffy! Colors Trap
programme.desc: Con Zoro, Nami y Vivi cada vez más cerca de convertirse en figuras de cera, de repente a Luffy no le dan ganas de salvar a sus amigos. ¿Qué le pasará a Luffy y qué relación tendrá Miss Golden Week con ello?

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Hora de contraatacar! ¡La rápida idea de Usopp y su Kaen Boshi!
programme.desc: Usopp consigue una manera para rescatar a Zoro y las chicas de la construcción de cera y a Luffy de su trance. Ya libres, pueden enfrentar a Mr. 3. Mientras tanto, Sanji encuentra el escondite de Mr. 3 y atiende una importante llamada telefónica.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Adiós, isla de los gigantes! Rumbo a Alabasta
programme.desc: Mientras Luffy y compañía se encargan de los oficiales de Baroque Works, Sanji habla con Mr. 0 y consigue un Eternal Pose que apunta a Alabasta. Ahora deberán partir de Little Garden y dejar a los gigantes atrás.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga
programme.desc: Luego de dejar Little Garden, los Sombrero de Paja notan que Namie tiene una fiebre muy alta y deciden salir en la búsqueda de un médico. A su vez, Vivi se entera de que la situación de su reino empeora y quiere llegar ahí cuanto antes.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga
programme.desc: En el medio de un clima frío y con nieve, los Sombrero de Paja vislumbran a un hombre parado sobre el mar. Al acercarse, son atacados por un gran barco pirata. Apurados por la situación de Nami, Luffy y los demás deberán lidiar rápido con ellos.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga
programme.desc: La tripulación llega a una isla de nieve donde reciben un recibimiento hostil. Tras un pequeño altercado, logran que los habitantes dejen que busquen a un médico para que vea a Nami, además se dice que es una bruja.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga
programme.desc: Luego de que Dalton les contara sobre la única médica que hay en la isla, Luffy y Sanji parten con Nami en su búsqueda. Mientras tanto, Dalton se entera de que dicha médica se encuentra en una aldea vecina y por lo tanto se cruzó con Luffy.

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga
programme.desc: Wapol regresa a Drum y pretende reclamar su trono, pero Dalton no permitirá que vuelva a oprimir al pueblo y luchará contra él.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: ¿Por qué hay dos Sougos? "Sougo # 2" es regañado por Tsukuyomi y Woz. Se sabe que vino de un futuro un poco más lejano, para ayudar a Geiz. Woz, que se opone a esta ayuda, decide reunirse con Swartz.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Geiz vuelve a la relojería. Estaba decidido a poder derrotar a Sougo en cualquier momento. Otro Jinete con la característica de absorber el alma humana comienza a atacar a las personas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Sougo termina convirtiéndose en un fantasma y no puede ser visto por Tsukuyomi y Geiz. Geiz deja la relojería y regresa hasta 2015 para restaurar el alma de Sougo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: ¿Por qué Sougo siempre quiso ser rey antes que nada? Sougo decide contarle a Tsukuyomi y a los demás sobre sus sueños habituales. Entonces, ¡los eventos que ocurrieron en tus sueños comenzaron a suceder!

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Sougo, cuando se encontró 50 años después, estaba muy decepcionado. Los robots gigantes aún permanecían en su mundo. Momentos después, en medio de una pequeña crisis de eventos entre Sougo y Geiz, Sougo toma una decisión.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Sougo eligió seguir luchando como Zi-O. Esta decisión acabó convirtiéndose en un punto de inflexión en el tiempo, y su paso acabó entrando en una fase desconocida.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: El segundo Woz puede transformarse en un Kamen Rider. Venía de un futuro diferente, donde Oma Zi-O desaparece. ¿Cuál es tu verdadera intención? Para derrotar a Otro Shinobi, necesitas el Shinobi Ride Watch.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
programme.desc: Aparece un nuevo y desconocido Another Rider. Con eso, Woz Preto, junto con Sougo, y Woz Branco, junto con Geiz, intentarán robar el poder de ese Otro Jinete para llevarlo al futuro que les conviene.

programme.title: Kamen Rider ZI-O
